fields.summary_ko.0: Nvidia management crisis has led to supply-chain stock declines at TSM (-9.5% MTD) and ASML (-10.8% MTD); however, Nvidia's strong Q3 results (EPS $2.68 vs consensus $2.47, revenue $115.84B exceeding by 7%) demonstrate solid underlying business.
fields.summary_ko.1: Nvidia provided Q4 revenue guidance of $130B with 110% data center revenue growth, with both TSM and ASML receiving positive Zacks Rank ratings.
